en.headline: Hot National Day, then showers over the long weekend
en.dek: The Observatory expects Thursday to stay very hot before cloud and rain become more likely from Friday through Sunday.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said National Day on Thursday should start mainly fine and very hot, with temperatures reaching about 33 to 34 degrees Celsius under light winds, before turning cloudier with a few showers later in the day.

Its nine-day forecast issued on Wednesday said Friday, the first working day after the public holiday, would be mainly cloudy with a few showers and isolated thunderstorms, as east winds pick up. Saturday and Sunday look similar: mainly cloudy with a few showers, and some sunny intervals on Sunday. Daytime highs over the rest of the weekend were put at about 27 to 31 degrees.

A Very Hot Weather Warning has remained in force. The Observatory said an anticyclone aloft would keep the Guangdong coast hot on Thursday, then weaken as a northeast monsoon brings cloudier, showery weather later in the week. Tropical Cyclone Surigae was expected to cross seas south of Japan and turn extratropical, without being forecast as a local signal threat.

From Monday, north to northeast winds were expected to strengthen a little, with more cloud, some rain patches and slightly lower morning temperatures. People heading out over the holiday were advised to watch for heat on Thursday and carry rain gear from Friday.

zh.headline: 國慶酷熱其後有驟雨 長假期天氣展望
zh.dek: 天文台預計星期四仍然酷熱，周五至周日轉多雲，有幾陣驟雨，局部地區或有雷暴。
body: 香港天文台表示，星期四國慶日大致天晴，日間酷熱，氣溫可達約33至34度，風力微弱，稍後轉多雲，有幾陣驟雨。
星期三發出的九天預報指，周五假期後首個工作天大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，局部地區有雷暴，東風加強。周六及周日同樣多雲有驟雨，周日日間間中有陽光。周末其餘日子最高氣溫約27至31度。
酷熱天氣警告仍然生效。天文台指高空反氣旋令廣東沿岸星期四仍然炎熱，其後反氣旋減弱，東北季候風令後期轉多雲有驟雨。熱帶氣旋舒力基預料橫過日本以南海域並逐漸變為溫帶氣旋，未有被預報為本港信號威脅。
周一起北至東北風稍 conceivably 加強，較多雲，有幾陣雨，早間氣溫略降。假期外出人士宜注意周四暑熱，周五起帶備雨具。
